local.fullPrompt: Create one wide 1672x941 scientific hypothetical observer illustration of the surface of asteroid 4 Vesta. Entirely independent invented terrain, no reference images and no reuse/recolouring of any observed Moon, Mars, Pluto or other body's map. Low camera looking across a modest cratered rocky regolith landscape, scattered angular blocks and granular dust, gently uneven distant crater rims and a black sky occupying upper half. Restrained neutral grey with very subtle warm undertone is artistic unknown visible colour. Hard directional off-frame sunlight, long shadows, no visible Sun or planets or astronomical discs, no stars needed. No spacecraft, people, structures, atmosphere, clouds, plume, liquid, ocean, biology, exposed interior or cutaway; do not imply survivable landing. Do not invent a measured geological site, chemistry, mineral fractions, exact grain size or date registration. Basaltic/HED association is broad scientific context, not locally measured material. Avoid spectacular cliffs or exposed iron. Clean photographic-looking rendering, no diagram. Add two large clearly legible footer lines in a dark unobtrusive bottom band: 'IMAGINED — VESTA LOCAL VIEW' and 'INVENTED TERRAIN, COLOUR & LIGHTING — NOT A DATED SITE'. Keep both lines fully inside the frame. This is a labelled hypothesis, not a native Dawn photograph or a calibrated map.

observer.fullPrompt: Create one independent wide 1672x941 scientific hypothetical observer illustration looking across asteroid 4 Vesta toward a broad black sky, with low rocky horizon only in the bottom third, a shallow foreground crater rim and scattered subdued angular regolith blocks. This is a separate imagined sky-facing scene, no reference images, no reuse or recolouring of any observed body's map. Neutral grey with slight warm undertone is artistic, not measured visible colour or chemistry. Hard off-frame sunlight from behind camera; Sun entirely outside frame, no planets, moons, astronomical discs or star field required. No atmosphere, haze, clouds, plume, liquid, ocean, biology, people, spacecraft, buildings, exposed interior or iron core. Do not imply survivable landing or a dated Dawn site. Terrain, grain/block scale, slopes, chemistry/fractions, colour, attitude, horizon and exposure are invented. HED association and interior models do not establish local composition. Composition should emphasize sky and a restrained distant horizon, not spectacular cliffs. Add two large fully legible footer lines in one dark bottom band: 'IMAGINED — SKY FROM VESTA' and 'INVENTED TERRAIN, COLOUR & LIGHTING — NOT A DATED SITE'. Keep both lines fully inside frame. Photographic-looking illustration clearly labelled hypothetical, not native imagery or calibrated geography.
